you_should_know.title: Legal experts weigh in on South County ICE facility lawsuit
you_should_know.summary: Santa Clara County (the county San Jose, CA sits in) and state leaders are gearing up for a legal battle to block a planned ICE facility in South County, the rural southern end of the county below San Jose. The lawsuit filed last month by California Attorney General Rob Bonta and county officials argues the federal government has illegally bypassed environmental laws, local zoning rules and other statutes in advancing the project just east...
